pins.definition: To perceive a sound with your ears.

situation: An old man sitting in a quiet forest clearing cups his ear toward a large, visible pulse of sound waves travelling through the air.
subject: the perception of sound
brief: An old man sits upright on a mossy forest stump with one hand cupped behind his ear, eyes closed in intense concentration. Emerging from a distant hidden cuckoo clock in the trees, a visible ribbon of golden acoustic waves ripples through the air toward him, terminating right at his open ear canal. The background forest is soft and dark, making the luminous, concentric sound rings the brightest thing in the composition.
